notes: FIRST PocketRoofline measurement on smartphone-class silicon (iPhone 13 / A15). Radios fully off (airplane mode, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth disabled), unplugged, app in foreground, single session run back-to-back SISO -> LISO -> SILO with one unrecorded warmup and ~3 s between repeats. PROTOCOL DEVIATION, recorded per METHODOLOGY 5: the device began at thermalState 'fair', not 'nominal' (the 10-minute ambient cooldown was not achieved before the session), and never returned to nominal. These are therefore warm-start figures. They are published as measured; the cold-start protocol run is a separate future session and will not overwrite this one. Long-prefill regime. Decode stays flat (42.58 t/s, sd 0.38) while prefill falls 12.3% across repeats (454.7 -> 398.6 t/s) as the device crosses from 'fair' into 'serious' thermal state. Repeat 0 is the transition and is flagged: its thermal state changed mid-run (fair -> serious), so it is excluded from any steady-state prefill aggregate and retained in full here, per METHODOLOGY 5.
